x: The sprint relay squad drafted in high hurdler Nick Cooper to secure a speedy second place and the long relay squad could then take it easy, knowing that our lead was unassailable.

With Nick Cooper also back from injury the sprint hurdles look brighter. Brendan Reilly too was back after his car accident and although he won the 'A' high jump, was not happy after failing at 2.20m.

Anyway, Andy Tulloch had already won the high hurdles, while Nick Cooper won the 'B' into a headwind. He was disappointed with the time as he was pushing for low 14's to gain selection for the European U23's.
